report.summaryEn: You performed well on the introduction and strength questions, but need to improve by linking your motivation to the company and asking questions at the end.

report.improveEn: Always connect your motivation to the specific company and ask a question at the end of the interview.

report.verdictReasonEn: Your strong technical examples show potential, but the lack of company-specific motivation and questions at the end needs improvement.

criteria.commentEn: You used polite keigo and greetings correctly throughout the interview.
You started with your strength clearly, but missed the conclusion in your motivation answer.
You gave a great specific example for your strength, but need more specifics for your motivation.
You did not connect your motivation or final question to Midori Design's specific work.
Your use of polite Japanese and humble expressions was very good.
Your answers were generally a good length, though the final question was too brief.
You showed a positive attitude when discussing your strength, but asking no questions at the end showed less interest.

improvements: Connect your motivation to the specific company's work.
Always ask a question at the end of the interview to show interest.
